actions.script: UserSecurityChecks.assertSealedGroupMembership(userGroupId, thruDate, eecaOperation == "update" && originalValue != null, originalValue != null ? originalValue.thruDate : null)

const updating = eecaOperation == "update" if (!updating || dstFieldExpression != originalValue?.dstFieldExpression) UserSecurityChecks.assertStoredExpression(dstFieldExpression, "AuthFlowFieldMap.dstFieldExpression") if ((!updating || srcFieldName != originalValue?.srcFieldName) && srcFieldName && !/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(String(srcFieldName))) UserSecurityChecks.assertStoredExpression(srcFieldName, "AuthFlowFieldMap.srcFieldName")

const destination = ['backupDir', 'systemMessageRemoteId', 'mirrorTransport', 'mirrorEncrypt', 'mirrorRecipient'] if (!ec.artifactExecution.authzDisabled() && destination.includes(String(parameterName ?? '')) && (eecaOperation != 'update' || parameterValue != originalValue?.parameterValue) && ec.entity.find('moqui.service.job.ServiceJob').condition('jobName', jobName).disableAuthz().one()?.serviceName == 'org.moqui.impl.ServerServices.backup#EmbeddedDatabase' && !ec.user.hasPermission('ADMIN_BACKUP_DOWNLOAD')) { const refused = new Error('Where a database backup goes is a download of the whole database: changing a backup job\'s ' + parameterName + ' needs ADMIN_BACKUP_DOWNLOAD') refused.moquiErrorKind = 'Unauthorized' throw refused }
